components.text:
Circle: medium circle, infernal chalk.

Curses the owner of the taglock: every second they lose 0.5% of their maximum magicules (at least 1), or 1% when the caster has a cat familiar.

Anyone can cast it. The target is the owner of the taglock; Tensura must be installed.

The curse ends when the target dies. It needs infernal chalk, not ritual chalk.
